rules.condition: Toxic vapours from liquids, V saturated ppm at 20C/101.3kPa; I if V>=10L and L<=1000; II V>=L and L<=3000; III V>=0.2L and L<=5000
rules.required_evidence: 1h LC50 ppm and saturated vapour ppm at 20C/101.3kPa

decision_logic.II: V>=LC50 and LC50<=3000 and not I
decision_logic.III: V>=LC50/5 and LC50<=5000 and not I/II
